queue.title: Silicon

queue.title: Semiconductor fabrication
queue.scope: Wafer-fab workflow from substrate to films, pattern transfer, doping, interconnect, process control and yield; distinguish equipment, technology node and device physics.

queue.title: Photolithography
queue.scope: Pattern transfer with masks/resists/optical or EUV exposure, imaging/resolution assumptions, overlay and process limits; distinct from entire fabrication flow.

queue.title: Thin-film deposition
queue.scope: CVD, PVD and ALD techniques, thickness/uniformity, chemical transport and process control; distinguish film growth from etching and lithography.

queue.title: Semiconductor etching
queue.scope: Wet and plasma etch mechanisms, selectivity, anisotropy and damage, with bounded process models; distinct from photolithography.
queue.source_leads: Journal of Vacuum Science and Technology; semiconductor process texts

queue.title: Semiconductor packaging
queue.scope: Package-level electrical/thermal/mechanical integration, interposers, 2.5D/3D integration and testing; distinguish wafer fabrication from chip packaging.

queue.title: Semiconductor foundry

queue.title: Neural processing unit

queue.title: Wafer testing

queue.title: Semiconductor manufacturing yield

queue.title: Motherboard
